claims.quote: Betta cracens is a mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from the Jambi area of Sumatra, Indonesia, and it may also occur on nearby Bangka island.
The type specimens were collected from the area of Bertam south of Jambi City, Jambi province, Sumatra, Indonesia and it may also occur on Pulau Bangka (Bangka island).
